$comment: Generated by scripts/schemas from trialfolio.contracts.attempt.StartRecordV1_1, in serialization mode. Validation and serialization modes give the same schema. Never edit it by hand.

Exchange.description:
One HTTP exchange the wrapper made through Trial Folio's transport adapter (HTTP
exchanges). Nothing else about it is kept: no headers, tokens, bodies, or exceptions.

request.description: The method and path, such as `POST /auth` or `POST /screen/backtest`.
request.title: Request

status.description: The HTTP status of a `response`; null otherwise.
status.title: Status

note.description:
Set only on a restarted attempt's request exchange, recorded as a 200 because its response
was found saved (uncertain completion); null otherwise.
note.title: Note

Exchange.title: Exchange

TransportVersions.description: The installed `requests` and `urllib3`, which carry the wrapper's requests.
TransportVersions.title: TransportVersions

WrapperVersions.description: The installed `p123api`, which sends the requests (plan contents).
WrapperVersions.title: WrapperVersions

description:
An experiment's start record, written durably just before the request is sent. Without
an attempt record beside it, the attempt is `running` (uncertain completion).

plan_hash.description: The plan the attempt runs under.
plan_hash.title: Plan Hash

session.description: The number of the session that started the attempt.
session.title: Session

sequence.description:
The attempt's place in its session: 1 for the first attempt it starts. It orders a
session's attempts, which their start times can't, because the clock can move backward.
sequence.title: Sequence

authenticated_by.description:
The attempt whose successful authentication gave the token the request is sent with: this
one, or an earlier one of its session.
authenticated_by.title: Authenticated By

repeat_of.description:
The attempt that `--repeat`'s confirmation named, for an attempt it started; null for any
other.
repeat_of.title: Repeat Of

exchanges.description:
The exchange completed before the send: Trial Folio's successful authentication call, or
none when the session already held a token.
exchanges.title: Exchanges

title: StartRecordV1_1
